name: Verve AI – Inventory Forecasting for WooCommerce
author: verveai

sections.description:
Verve AI is an AI-powered inventory forecasting and purchasing platform for WooCommerce merchants.

Stop relying on spreadsheets, guesswork, and manual stock calculations. Verve AI analyzes your WooCommerce sales history, inventory levels, supplier lead times, and purchasing activity to help you make smarter inventory decisions.

From demand forecasting and reorder planning to supplier management and purchase order creation, Verve AI gives growing businesses the tools they need to reduce stockouts, avoid overstocking, and improve cash flow.

Ideal For:

  • WooCommerce merchants managing physical inventory
  • Businesses struggling with stockouts and excess inventory
  • Stores that want to replace spreadsheets with data-driven purchasing
  • Growing brands that need better visibility into inventory performance
  • Teams looking for forecasting and purchasing tools without complex ERP systems

Key Features

AI Inventory Agent

Receive proactive inventory insights through an AI-powered activity feed.

The Verve AI Agent continuously monitors your inventory and highlights issues that require attention.

Automatically surfaces:

  • Purchase order opportunities
  • Low-stock warnings
  • Demand spike alerts
  • Slow-moving inventory
  • Dead stock risks
  • Declining sales velocity notifications

Users can configure thresholds and snooze or dismiss alerts as needed.

Inventory Health Dashboard

Get an instant overview of inventory performance across your catalog.

Inventory classifications include:

  • Healthy Inventory
  • Stockout Risk
  • Overstock Risk
  • Dead Stock
  • Out of Stock

Monitor:

  • Weeks of cover
  • Inventory value at risk
  • Cash tied up in stock
  • Product velocity
  • Lead-time performance

Quickly identify which products need action and where inventory investment is being wasted.

AI Demand Forecasting

Forecast future product demand using historical WooCommerce sales data.

  • AI-powered demand forecasting
  • Product-level demand projections
  • Trend and sales velocity analysis
  • Lead-time aware inventory planning
  • Smarter purchasing recommendations

Smart Reorder Planning

Know what to buy and when to buy it.

  • AI-generated reorder suggestions
  • Lead-time aware replenishment planning
  • Supplier-based purchasing recommendations
  • Demand-driven inventory targets
  • Reduced stockout risk

Purchase Order Management

Create and manage purchase orders directly from forecast recommendations.

Features include:

  • Create purchase orders from AI suggestions
  • Create manual purchase orders
  • Edit quantities, costs, and expected delivery dates
  • Track open purchase orders
  • Receive stock against purchase orders
  • Export purchase orders
  • Automatically sync received purchase orders with your store

Supplier Management

Manage supplier relationships and purchasing performance in one place.

Capabilities include:

  • Supplier performance scorecards
  • Supplier lead-time tracking
  • Cost drift monitoring
  • Pricelist CSV imports
  • Product-to-supplier matching

Gain greater visibility into supplier reliability and purchasing costs.

Inventory Reporting Suite

Access a growing library of inventory and purchasing reports.

Built-in reports include:

  • Inventory Valuation
  • Dead Stock Exposure
  • Stock Movement Analysis
  • Sell-Through Rate
  • Product Velocity Trends
  • Stockout History
  • Reorder Cadence
  • Purchase Order History
  • Supplier Performance
  • Cost Drift Analysis
  • Top & Bottom Performing Products
  • Purchasing Summary
  • Sales & Inventory Summary

Turn inventory data into actionable business insights.

Benefits

  • Reduce stockouts before they happen
  • Avoid overstocking and excess inventory
  • Improve cash flow and inventory efficiency
  • Make faster purchasing decisions
  • Eliminate spreadsheet-based inventory planning
  • Gain visibility into inventory health and supplier performance
  • Save time on forecasting and replenishment planning

Verve AI helps WooCommerce merchants buy smarter, stock smarter, and grow with confidence.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect your WooCommerce store to Verve AI
  3. Create your Verve AI account
  4. Sync products and orders securely
  5. View forecasts and manage purchase orders in the Verve AI dashboard

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • An active Verve AI account

External Services

This plugin connects to the Verve AI external service to provide inventory forecasting and purchase order functionality.

Service URL:
https://app2.getverveai.com

The plugin cannot function without this external service.

Why External Processing Is Required

Inventory forecasting requires analyzing historical sales patterns, trends, and seasonality. This processing is performed on Verve AI’s secure servers to ensure accuracy and performance without impacting your WordPress site.

Data Transmitted to Verve AI

The following store data may be transmitted securely:

  • Store domain and basic store settings (currency, timezone)
  • Product data (titles, SKUs, prices, inventory levels)
  • Historical order data (order dates, quantities, line items)

No customer personal data (such as customer names, emails, addresses, payment details, or passwords) is transmitted or stored.

When Data Is Transmitted

  • During initial store connection (OAuth authentication)
  • During product and order synchronization (manual or automated)
  • When generating forecasts or accessing the dashboard

Data Retention

Store data is retained while your Verve AI account is active.
If you disconnect your store or delete your account, all associated data is permanently deleted within 30 days.

Service Policies

  • Terms of Service: https://app2.getverveai.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://app2.getverveai.com/privacy-policy

User Consent

By connecting your WooCommerce store to Verve AI, you consent to the data transmission described above.
You may revoke consent at any time by disconnecting the plugin from the WordPress admin.
sections.installation:
1. Add the Verve AI plugin from the WordPress store
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to Verve AI in the WordPress admin sidebar
  4. Click Connect to Verve AI and follow the setup steps
sections.faq:
Do I need a Verve AI account?

Yes. The plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the Verve AI forecasting platform.
Account details and pricing are available at https://getverveai.com.

How does the forecasting work?

Verve AI analyzes your WooCommerce order history using an AI forecasting model that emphasizes recent sales while incorporating longer-term historical trends.

Does Verve AI access customer personal data?

No. Verve AI only processes aggregated order and product data for forecasting purposes.
Customer personal information is not transmitted or stored.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication is encrypted, and authentication is handled using secure OAuth tokens.
WooCommerce admin credentials are never stored.

Can I disconnect my store?

Yes. You can disconnect at any time from the plugin settings page.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Compatibility release aligned with the latest Verve AI hosted dashboard
  • Dashboard improvements: grouped auto purchase-order suggestions on the Agentic Feed (variants of the same product + supplier are now combined into a single card)
  • Dashboard improvements: Expected Date and other purchase-order fields are now editable after a PO has been sent
  • Forecasting accuracy tweaks to the v2 lead-time algorithm
  • Updated “Tested up to” for WordPress 7.0
  • No breaking changes to the plugin itself

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • WooCommerce OAuth connection
  • Secure session-based authentication
  • Product and order synchronization
  • Webhook support for real-time updates
